01

“And they say, 'Our hearts are within coverings'”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 41:5).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
And they say, 'Our hearts are within coverings' [Fussilat 5] meaning: "like a quiver for arrows."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَقَالُوا قُلُوبُنَا فِي أَكِنَّةٍ [فصلت: 5] ، يَعْنِي: «كَالْجَعْبَةِ لِلنَّبْلِ»
Edition record 373270 · p. 585Link to report ↗

06

“And you were not concealing yourselves”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 41:22).

07
Explanation from Mujāhid 07

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
And you were not concealing yourselves [Fussilat 22] he said: "He says: you were not guarding yourselves," lest your hearing testify against you, nor your sight, nor your skins [Fussilat 22].
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ [فصلت: 22] قَالَ: " يَقُولُ: مَا كُنْتُمْ تَتَّقُونَ "، أَنْ يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلَا أَبْصَارُكُمْ وَلَا جُلُودُكُمْ [فصلت: 22]
Edition record 373276 · p. 585Link to report ↗

08

“and talk noisily during it”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 41:26).

09
Explanation from Mujāhid 09

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
and talk noisily during it [Fussilat 26] he said: "meaning with whistling, hand-clapping, and confusing the speech of the Messenger of God ﷺ when he recited the Qur'an; Quraysh did this."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَالْغَوْا فِيهِ [فصلت: 26] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي بِالْمُكَاءِ وَالتَّصْفِيرِ وَالتَّخْلِيطِ فِي الْمِنْطَقِ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ قُرَيْشٌ تَفْعَلُهُ»
Edition record 373278 · p. 586Link to report ↗

English

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 41:40).

Explanation from Mujāhid 12

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording

الإسناد

12

“Why have its verses not been explained in detail?”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and Saʿīd ibn Jubayr (Q 41:44).

13
Explanation from Mujāhid 13

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Why have its verses not been explained in detail? [Fussilat 44] He says: "why have its verses not been explained in detail ⦗p. 587⦘ and made Arabic? God, Mighty and Majestic, says: foreign [Fussilat 44] speech and Arab [Fussilat 44] the man?"
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
لَوْلَا فُصِّلَتْ آيَاتُهُ [فصلت: 44] يَقُولُ: «لَوْلَا فُصِّلَتْ آيَاتُهُ ⦗ص: 587⦘ فَجُعِلَ عَرَبِيًّا يَقُولُ اللَّهُ عز وجل» ، أَأَعْجَمِيٌّ [فصلت: 44] «الْكَلَامُ» ، وَعَرَبِيٌّ [فصلت: 44] «الرَّجُلُ؟»
Edition record 373282 · p. 586Link to report ↗
14
Report from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr 14

Saʿīd ibn Jubayr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Abu Awana related to us, from Abu Bishr, from Said ibn Jubayr, who said:
"an Arab man and a foreign tongue."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ:
«رَجُلٌ عَرَبِيٌّ وَلِسَانٌ أَعْجَمِيٌّ»
Edition record 373283 · p. 587Link to report ↗

14

“he will surely say, 'This is due to me'”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 41:50).

16
Explanation from Mujāhid 16

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
he will surely say, 'This is due to me' [Fussilat 50] that is: "due to my work, and I am entitled and deserving of this."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
لَيَقُولَنَّ هَذَا لِي [فصلت: 50] أَيْ: «بِعَمَلِي، وَأَنَا مَحْقُوقٌ بِهَذَا مُسْتَحِقٌّ»
Edition record 373285 · p. 587Link to report ↗
